# Prompt: docs-developer-facing

**Skill id:** `docs-developer-facing`

READMEs, API docs, and how-to for engineers.

---

Developer-facing documentation

## When to use
Feature needs adoption or support burden reduction.

## MUST
- Clear prerequisites, install, config, and troubleshooting.
- Link to ADRs or specs; keep examples copy-paste safe (no real secrets).

## Verification
- [ ] New user can follow doc without private context
